notes.title: New visuals and demo updates!
notes.content: [h2]Demo updates[/h2][p]Since June, we’ve been hard at work making the Demo the best it can be! Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p][b]New content:[/b] Second map ([i]Snowy Snowers[/i]), tutorial, Gem ability system, unlockables, Miner health system, and more augments & gems.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Systems & features:[/b] Miner passives, helper tools for new players, and better visual clarity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quality of life:[/b] Steam Deck support, Gem list, accessibility settings, camera edge panning, and loads of polish.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465950/f86741ab63925812ef90f7a0d9bbf6ef90898fcf.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Visuals[/h2][p]Brand new visuals! We’ve refreshed the look with a new [b]logo, Steam page art,[/b] and a [b]shiny animated main menu[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465950/c27c0f94758eeeabe51dba0dc3fc2e92e4dce897.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Skins are coming with the full release![/b] 🎉[/h2][p]Skins are coming with full release! Demo players will receive an exclusive skin, and your save file will carry over into the full game. We’re also planning a small supporter pack at launch that would include a few skins. Skins will be unlocked through hard-earned achievements.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465950/1fb68104037cafdeacead65ec651db116f6bcd18.png"][/img][/p][h2]What's Next for Gem Miner TD[/h2][p]Stay tuned, more demo updates (and some secret cool stuff) are coming before [b]Finnish Games Week[/b] and [b]Next Fest[/b] early next month.[/p][p]The [b]release date[/b] will be revealed later this month/early next, and we will make sure the game launches with a big discount![/p][p][i]-iFeral[/i][/p]
